prose: Gary Marcus argues against buying Anthropic's IPO, citing a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, nearly $900 billion in future liabilities and a history of losses apart from one subsidized quarter. He quotes critics such as Ed Zitron on slowing Q3 revenue growth and passages in the amended S-1 that admit costs and losses will continue and that growth will not stay at comparable rates. It is an opinion piece built on quoted posts.
highlights: Cites about $895B in commitments and past losses
Quotes S-1 language on continued losses
Relies on other commentators, such as Zitron
